schemaAttribution.users: CREATE TABLE users(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,password TEXT NOT NULL);
schemaAttribution.lobbies: CREATE TABLE lobbies(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,data TEXT NOT NULL);

queries.sql: SELECT id,username FROM users WHERE username IN ('Guest-761629','Guest-83780b') ORDER BY username;

SELECT id, json_extract(data,'$.hostId') AS hostId, json_extract(data,'$.revision') AS revision, json_extract(data,'$.matchId') AS matchId, json_extract(data,'$.seats[0].side') AS seat0Side, json_extract(data,'$.seats[0].account.id') AS seat0AccountId, json_extract(data,'$.seats[0].account.username') AS seat0Username, json_extract(data,'$.seats[1].side') AS seat1Side, json_extract(data,'$.seats[1].account.id') AS seat1AccountId, json_extract(data,'$.seats[1].account.username') AS seat1Username, json_extract(data,'$.seats[2].controller') AS seat2Controller, json_extract(data,'$.seats[3].controller') AS seat3Controller FROM lobbies WHERE id='9ba577e1-bf62-41c4-954c-f4ac1a16c172';

screenshotAttribution.visibleTextLocation: The host lobby list is in the upper half of the Online play dialog. The 9ba577e1 row spans about x=316..1124, y=419..480; its View lobby button is about x=1003..1112, y=428..470.
screenshotAttribution.observation: Guest-761629 is the signed-in host. View lobby is expected because the host owns seat 0.

screenshotAttribution.visibleTextLocation: Guest-83780b is shown near x=316..1124, y=190..210. The visible dialog then shows the create form from about y=348 through the bottom edge; no lobby-list row or lobby action button is visible in this frame.

attributionConclusion: The users have distinct IDs. Guest-761629 owns seat 0, seat 1 remains empty, and the other two seats are AI. The visible View lobby label belongs to the host image. No second-guest UI/server mismatch is established.
sanitization: Contains only account UUIDs, generated guest usernames, lobby UUID, revision, match presence, and seat mapping. No password, session row, cookie, token, or credential value was queried or retained.
